claim: Every acquired ARG occurrence resolves to a documented chromosome or plasmid
reason: 74,349 occurrences, 0 unmatched, 0 ambiguous, 0 missing coordinates; reconciled again in this audit
required_qualifier: state that this holds for closed genomes only

claim: Occurrence-weighted plasmid share 52.736 pct; genome-weighted 36.586 pct
reason: both verified exactly (52.736419 pct; 3,569/9,755 = 36.586366 pct), but genome-weighted means collapsed-to-one-event-per-genome, not the mean of per-genome percentages (35.932 pct)
required_qualifier: print the collapsing definition beside the 36.586 pct figure

claim: Five evidence-ranked portability classes summing to the denominator
required_qualifier: state that classes are evidence-ranked, not a risk score

claim: Portability is a property of the occurrence: 164 families occur in both compartments
reason: the count is sound, but Wang and Dagan 2021 (PMID 34839702) already report 33 pct of 416 ARGs shared between compartments
affects_central_narrative: no - it is supporting, not central
required_qualifier: cite the prior work and present this as confirmation at occurrence level

claim: 46.39 pct of chromosomal ARG occurrences lie within 10 kb of a mobile-element marker
evidence_class: measured result validated by expert audit
reason: verified at 46.394422 pct; NM-V1C validates the underlying call at 0.9920; NM-DIST now shows the association is not a threshold artefact - it is concentrated at short range, with the A. baumannii contrast largest at 2 kb rather than 10 kb
required_qualifier: state the MOBILE-versus-QUIESCENT validation scope, the +/-10 kb window and that marker-negative occurrences are right-censored at 10 kb
nmdist_effect: STRENGTHENED - threshold shown not to be load-bearing

claim: Chromosomal location is not equivalent to genomic fixity
reason: follows from C05 with NM-V1C support, and is now spatially resolved by NM-DIST: median nearest-marker distance 647 bp in A. baumannii against not-reached in both comparators
required_qualifier: must not be phrased as demonstrated mobilisation

claim: Block-weighted chromosomal MGE positivity is 30.14 pct against 46.39 pct occurrence-weighted
reason: verified: 6,617/21,955 = 30.1389 pct; marker-positive blocks carry 2.4806 ARGs against 1.2209, a 2.01x ratio; NM-DIST leaves both the 46.39 pct and 30.14 pct estimates unchanged and shows the contrast survives block balancing
affects_central_narrative: yes - it is the honest denominator disclosure
required_qualifier: both figures must appear together, never one alone

claim: A. baumannii has the lowest plasmid share and the highest chromosomal MGE association
reason: verified 13.96 pct plasmid / 80.91 pct chromosomal MGE; ratio 2.2024 occurrence-weighted and 2.4577 block-weighted; survives BioProject collapse and LOBO; NM-DIST adds that 93 pct of its marker-positive detections fall within 2 kb and that the excess is essentially entirely IS/transposase-driven
required_qualifier: state that no chromosomal lineage control exists (no MLST or SNP distance)
nmdist_effect: STRENGTHENED - short-range concentration and IS attribution

claim: Plasmid fraction and chromosomal MGE association are dissociable - the discordance principle
supporting_module: NM-V4 confirmation species; A. baumannii out-of-model residual; low-plasmid P. aeruginosa control; NM-V2 BioProject-balanced; NM-V4C family-conditioned; PC2; NM-V1C; NM-V3
reason: ab_residual 2.1126, CI 1.8065-2.4376 excluding zero, confirmed off the discovery species; the low between-species R2 of 0.0275 is positive evidence of non-redundancy, not a weakness
affects_central_narrative: yes - this is the conceptual advance
required_qualifier: state that plasmid fraction explains almost none of the between-species variation in chromosomal-MGE association - that is the point, not a caveat

claim: Determinant-host-vehicle principle: within a family, the host decides the vehicle
reason: supported in direction, but Amendment 001 marks G5 NOT ROBUST ACROSS CO-PRIMARY ESTIMATORS
required_qualifier: never restate 7 of 7 gates; state the G5 qualification

claim: A. baumannii versus Klebsiella on PC2
reason: PC2 ln OR 3.196 with CI excluding 1, but SC5 fails on family-weight concentration
required_qualifier: state SC5 false

claim: A. baumannii versus P. aeruginosa on PC1
reason: PC1 ln OR 2.806 but max family weight share 0.505 and blaOXA leave-one-family-out 0.415
required_qualifier: explicitly limited; not a general claim

claim: Conjugation-consistent replicons carry more convergent cargo
reason: difference +19.861 pp, BioProject-clustered CI 14.160-25.414 excluding zero, direction and significance preserved in every tool, database and rule variant
required_qualifier: state that conjugation is predicted from markers, never demonstrated

claim: Class C/D/E boundaries are stable to mobility-marker database and version
reason: 0.0000 pct replicon category change in both arms; but only two database versions and no tool newer than 3.1.9 exist
affects_central_narrative: no - it is a robustness claim
required_qualifier: scope the claim to existing versions; version-stamp every C/D/E figure

claim: Frozen class E: relaxase plus MPF, 66.301104 pct of plasmid-borne occurrences
reason: operationally defined, zero version sensitivity, kappa 0.875 against an independent implementation; 61.24 pct corroborated by both tools
required_qualifier: print the operational definition; report the 61.24 pct corroborated figure

claim: E1/E2 evidence-depth distinction
reason: E1 16,397 on 2,828 replicons; E2 9,599 on 1,109; E2 is 36.924912 pct of E and 24.481624 pct of plasmid-borne
required_qualifier: no detected oriT is not equivalent to biological absence of oriT

claim: High-concern plasmid convergence (1,455 architectures, 21.98 pct)
reason: supported by the C09 contrast surviving every arm
required_qualifier: co-location on one replicon, not co-transfer or co-selection

claim: Geographic, host, source-context and clinical-status distributions
reason: metadata coverage is partial and no confounding control was performed
required_qualifier: descriptive only; no causal or geographic inference

claim: Any causal or geographic interpretation
reason: no causal design exists anywhere in this study
required_qualifier: not to be made

claim: The +/-20 kb neighbourhood sensitivity
reason: windows were never extracted at 20 kb
required_qualifier: state as a limitation

claim: Any claim implying demonstrated transfer, HGT, conjugation, phenotype or co-selection
reason: no mating experiment, transconjugant, transfer assay or phenotype exists in this dataset
required_qualifier: prohibited wording throughout

claim: The pipeline recovers known determinant biology blind
reason: supported, but it is an internal-validity argument
required_qualifier: present as internal validity, not external validation

claim: The analysis is independently reproducible
reason: the mobility layer was re-derived exactly on a clean machine, but NM-V5 deposition does not yet exist
required_qualifier: call it computational reproduction, not independent validation

claim: The dataset is a reusable public resource
reason: NM-V5 has not started and the data dictionary does not exist
required_qualifier: cannot be claimed until NM-V5 completes

claim: PlasmidCall integration extends the framework to draft assemblies
reason: NM-V6 was never authorised and gplasCC (PMID 41837270) now occupies the niche
required_qualifier: cite an existing tool instead; remove PlasmidCall from Paper 1

claim: mcr-9 and plus-scope colistin determinants are outside the primary denominator
reason: correct and already recorded; -6.55 pp in the sensitivity table
required_qualifier: any colistin statement must use the S1 set

claim: The chromosomal MGE association is a short-range spatial signature, predominantly IS/transposase
reason: block-balanced F(d) with BioProject bootstrap; A. baumannii contrast largest at 2 kb (+0.4651) and 93 pct of its detections within 2 kb; IS-only endpoint reproduces the primary result while the integrase/integron endpoint shows no A. baumannii excess (-0.0136 at 10 kb) NMIS corroborates this structurally at census scale: 73.80 percent of class-B occurrences carry a fully contained complete IS, 86.01 percent in A. baumannii, with the same species ordering and IS6 retaining 90.4 percent of elements through the structural gate.
affects_central_narrative: yes - it is the spatial half of the chromosomal route
required_qualifier: no intact-transposon, mobilization, transfer or phenotype claim; no distance beyond 10 kb
nmdist_effect: NEW - reported by NM-DIST, structurally corroborated by NMIS

claim: Structurally resolved complete insertion sequences reproduce the host-conditioned chromosomal signature under the strictest available endpoint
reason: census of 21,955 blocks under one pinned environment; A. baumannii F(1kb) 0.3531 against 0.0633 Klebsiella and 0.0276 P. aeruginosa; N1 +0.2898 and N2 +0.3255 at 1 kb, all CIs excluding zero, Holm p = 0.001; 86.9 percent of A. baumannii structural detections within 2 kb
affects_central_narrative: yes - it is the structural half of the chromosomal route
required_qualifier: must be worded as STRUCTURAL DETECTION, never as transposition, transfer or experimental mobility; non-detection stated as 'no structurally resolved IS detected under the frozen ISEScan definition'
